messages:
elaine: customer reported our JS quickstart fails in a Cloudflare Worker after latest publish (starter sample).
jorge: error?
elaine: `TypeError: (0 , _client.default) is not a function` when they do `import client from '@redwood/inference'`.
nina: sounds like ESM default export missing. Edge runtimes are strict.
sam: we changed the exports map last month; maybe the esm entry only exposes named exports now.
jorge: quick mitigation: publish a tiny `dist/edge/index.mjs` that re-exports the ESM bundle with an explicit default. e.g. `import c from '../esm/index.mjs'; export default c; export * from '../esm/index.mjs';`
elain: also need to ensure `package.json` exports include a `worker` condition so CF picks it: "exports": { ".": { "worker": "./dist/edge/index.mjs", "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js" } }
sam: CI follow-ups: add smoke tests that pack the tarball and verify Node ESM default import, Node CJS require, and a miniflare worker import using esbuild bundle. Gate publish on those.
release-bot: automated: will require `smoke/cf-compat` to pass before npm publish.
jorge: I'll push hotfix branch with the adapter and export changes now.
nina: update quickstart docs to prefer named import `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference'` until fix is published.
elaine: I'll notify the customer and link PR when ready.
sam: follow-up: long-term policy: ESM-first with CI-enforced CJS parity and explicit `worker` export.
elaine: thanks all. :thumbsup:
